evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a test case as reproducing a production failure pattern invokes a hierarchy where the production environment's behavior is the authority the local work must answer to.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Imperative 'must' clauses issue a command constraining the implementer's behavior — hierarchy enacted through directive speech.
